What calls what

The app-lock file, coverage-guided.

Worse than the container in one specific way: this file is parsed before anyone has authenticated anything. It is the first bytes the program touches on a locked machine, so anything that can write it gets a free shot at the parser -- and at the Argon2 cost parameters it carries, which is exactly where F-2 and F-3 were.
